title: On the existence of pure epsilon-equilibria
abstract: arXiv:2502.07585v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Departing from optimizing behavior by any $\epsilon>0$ ensures the existence of stable outcomes in a broad class of many-agent games where utilities are drawn from a joint distribution. Specifically, in a game with iid drawn utilities from a continuous distribution and any $\epsilon>0$, we show that as the number of agents gets large the probability that a pure $\epsilon$-equilibrium exists converges to 1, while, by contrast, the probability that a pure Nash equilibrium exists is known to converge to $1-1/e\approx 0.63$. The asymptotic existence of pure $\epsilon$-equilibrium extends to utilities that are negatively correlated across agents, and we identify a correlation threshold dependent on $\epsilon$ that is tight for the zero-sum case. We also study the cases of correlation across action profiles and of utility ties and, in all cases, we also characterize the asymptotic distribution of pure $\epsilon$-equilibria. Regarding pure

translated_abstract: 偏离最优行为任意 ε>0，即可确保在广泛的一类多智能体博弈（其效用从联合分布中抽取）中存在稳定的结果。具体而言，在效用从连续分布独立同分布抽取的博弈中，对于任意 ε>0，我们证明随着智能体数量的增大，纯 ε-均衡存在的概率收敛于 1；相比之下，众所周知，纯纳什均衡存在的概率仅收敛于 1-1/e ≈ 0.63。纯 ε-均衡的渐近存在性还可扩展到效用跨智能体负相关的情形，并且我们识别出一个依赖于 ε 的相关性阈值，该阈值在零和博弈情形下是紧的。我们还研究了行动组合间的相关性以及效用平局的情形，并且在所有情形下，我们都刻画了纯 ε-均衡的渐近分布。
tldr: 本文证明在效用随机抽取的大型多智能体博弈中，只要允许偏离最优行为任意小的 ε>0，纯 ε-均衡存在的概率随智能体数量增大趋近于 1，而纯纳什均衡存在的概率仅趋近于约 0.63。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in large many-agent games with randomly drawn utilities, allowing any small deviation ε>0 from optimizing behavior ensures the existence of pure ε-equilibria with probability approaching 1 as the number of agents grows, whereas pure Nash equilibria exist with probability only approaching about 0.63.
